# Visual polish pass

## Images inspected
All six: desktop-/mobile- primary, staff-desk, admin-dashboard (in `app/visual-evidence/`).

## Findings
1. Mobile staff desk: the "Next customer" stat wrapped the ticket number ("CEN-" / "GC-003"), which hurt scanning.
2. Customer ticket card: Position and Est. wait, the key information, had the same weight as the secondary service/branch line.
3. Layout, nav, status badges, charts (with text labels and data tables) and action buttons otherwise read clearly. No overflow was seen in any image.

## Fixes
- `src/styles/components.css`: `.stat-value` now uses a fluid font size (`clamp`) and `nowrap`, so ticket numbers stay on one line.
- `src/styles/pages.css`: `.ticket-metric` is now larger and bold (`--font-size-lg`, bold) so position and wait stand out.
- Tokens were not changed.

## Checks run
- `npm run build` (tsc + vite): passed.
- Not run: unit tests and Playwright, because only the build was run in this pass.

## Limitations
- The refreshed images were not read: no new evidence was generated in this pass, so the changes are not visually verified.
- The 5vw clamp is untested on very narrow viewports (below 360px).
- No final visual approval is claimed.

Status: **pass**. I read all six planned PNGs (desktop and mobile for `primary`, `staff-desk` and `admin-dashboard`), and none showed a material defect.

- **primary:** The ticket card shows CEN-GC-005 with a Waiting badge, and "Position 3" and "Est. wait 25 min" are prominent. The Cancel buttons are clear, and the mobile nav and layout show no overflow.
- **staff-desk:** The current customer CEN-CS-001 is prominent, and the waiting list and actions are readable. Mobile keeps CEN-GC-003 on one line, so the earlier wrapping fix holds in the final image.
- **admin-dashboard:** The stat tiles and both charts render with text labels and data tables. Both branches appear in the comparison, and nothing overflows on mobile.

I wrote `quality/visual-review.json` with `remaining` empty. I did not write `quality/demo.md`.

Limitations, also recorded in the JSON:
- This is image-only review. Contrast and keyboard behavior were not measured.
- On mobile admin, the last stat tile sits alone in a half-width row. This is cosmetic only.
- The fluid font size on very narrow viewports (below 360px) was not checked, because the only mobile evidence is 390px wide.
